completed_event_scope: Previously accepted analytical main/source/tree through PR154 and six completed native metadata/banner readbacks; inference, classes, ceilings and original evaluations remain unchanged.

final_record_publication.scope: Publication/integration of these final wrapper and delivery-record bytes is certified by their exact later Git/CI history. This manifest contains no future own-commit SHA and does not self-certify that separate event.

accepted_original_manifest.role: Unchanged construction-time delivery snapshot subsequently accepted through PR154. Original pending construction fields remain historical and do not override the completed events here.

evaluation_limits: Original seven source continuations remain PARTIAL. Original process/application failures, separate nonblind repairs and nonempirical ensemble applications remain versioned. Authority cutover adds no primary-source reading, blind score, empirical accuracy or confidence promotion.

manifest_self_binding.binding: Exact self bytes and all180 named paths are bound by the separate staging/index/readback receipt and Git blob/tree; a self hash is never substituted into this manifest.
